headline: Minimum wage increase 'affects 7.89 million people's health insurance' – an average of NT$26 more per month - ETtoday Health Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: The Ministry of Health and Welfare said over 7.89 million people will be affected by the minimum wage rise and related health insurance changes. The average increase is NT$26 per month.
why: Minimum wage increases raise labour costs for employers, especially low-wage sectors such as retail and hospitality.
